name: Frère Jacques
source: the traditional round, first voice, written out by hand

transcription.by: Claude, from the tune as it is usually printed
transcription.covers: one voice, all 8 bars, no round
transcription.notes: The control case: every bar is played exactly twice, so every approach should find the same pairs. 2026/midis/frere-jacques.mid is the same tune in F, written in sixteenths, with gaps before the long notes.
